question: Find the value of 18 ÷ {(7 of 3 - 12)} × 9 × (11-7).
solution:
**Given:**

Find the value of 18 ÷ {(7 of 3 - 12)} × 9 × (11-7).

**Formula used:**

Operations inside the brackets should be performed first, followed by division and multiplication.

**Calculation:**

18 ÷ {(7 of 3 - 12)} × 9 × (11-7)

⇒ 18 ÷ {(7 × 3 - 12)} × 9 × 4

⇒ 18 ÷ (21 - 12) × 36

⇒ 18 ÷ 9 × 36

⇒ 2 × 36 = 72

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
